input.title: Ignore trailing blank lines when parsing a statement
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement only strips a single trailing empty string left by a final newline. When a statement file ends with a genuine blank line after the last transaction, one empty line remains after that pop and gets parsed as a data row, failing assertShape with "Malformed row" at the row just past the last transaction. Change the trailing-line handling to drop all trailing empty lines (or skip blank lines generally while iterating data rows), not just the last one.

file: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement only removes a single trailing empty string (the one left by a final newline). When the file has an actual blank line after the last transaction, one empty line remains in `lines` after that pop and is then parsed as a data row, failing assertShape with "Malformed row" at the row just past the last transaction. The fix is to drop all trailing blank lines (or skip blank lines while iterating), not just the last one.
